title: Rosehip and vitamin E facial oil
subtitle: A lightweight serum oil for dry and mature skin
excerpt: Rosehip seed oil blended with jojoba and a few drops of frankincense essential oil in an amber dropper bottle. High in linoleic acid and absorbs readily. Apply two to three drops at night. Makes 30 ml; keeps six months.
sourceNotes: Rosehip seed oil fatty acid profile and cosmetic use: Phetcharat, L. et al., 'The effectiveness of a standardized rose hip powder', European Journal of Clinical Nutrition (2015, open access summary). Jojoba oil stability as long-chain wax ester: INCI database reference. Frankincense (Boswellia carterii) essential oil cosmetic use: general aromatherapy and cosmetic science reference.

recipe.yieldDescription: 30 ml facial oil (~60 applications at 2 drops per use)
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make 30 ml at a time because rosehip oil has a short shelf life once blended.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Keeps six months in a sealed amber dropper bottle in the fridge. Rosehip seed oil oxidises faster than most carrier oils; refrigeration extends the shelf life significantly. Discard if the oil turns cloudy, smells rancid, or the dropper bottle feels sticky on the outside from oxidised oil residue.

glossaryTerms.definition: An omega-6 polyunsaturated fatty acid found in high concentrations in rosehip seed oil (around 40 to 50%). Skin that is deficient in linoleic acid tends to produce thicker, stickier sebum and is more prone to blocked pores. Topical linoleic acid is thought to restore barrier function.

content.text: Rosehip seed oil is a lightweight carrier oil with a high

content and a thin, fast-absorbing texture. This blend dilutes it slightly with jojoba for stability and adds frankincense essential oil for a faint, resinous scent. Use two to three drops at night on clean, slightly damp skin. Rosehip has a short shelf life; refrigerate and make small batches.
Patch test on the forearm before first use. Leave for 24 hours.

items.prepNote: cold-pressed rosehip seed oil; keep refrigerated after opening
stabilises the blend and extends shelf life
6% of formula; optional; adds a warm, resinous note and supports the skin-feel

content.text: Pour the rosehip oil and jojoba oil into the amber dropper bottle.
Add the frankincense essential oil if using.
Fit the dropper cap. Swirl gently to blend. Label with the date made.
Apply two to three drops to clean, slightly damp skin at night. Press the oil in with the palms rather than rubbing. Allow to absorb for a few minutes before applying other products or going to bed.

Keeps six months in a sealed amber dropper bottle in the fridge. The amber glass protects against light-triggered oxidation. Discard if the oil smells sharp or rancid rather than mild and faintly nutty.
